name: Twinway Palm
description: Strike with one palm while the other yields so both hands act along a single Way.

name: Twinway Guard
description: Hold two soft guards that trade the weight of a blow back and forth between them.

name: Twinway Step
description: Pace on two lines at once so the foe cannot tell which foot will carry the body.

name: Twinway Sense
description: Feel the same room by two Ways at once and note where they disagree.

name: Paired Yielding
description: Yield with both arms so a blow slides from one into the other and out the far side.

name: Twinway Bind
description: Close two soft holds on the target that tighten each time they pull against one.

name: Twinway Calm
description: Lay a calm over the target from two sides until their qi sinks and slows.

name: Twinway Strike
description: Land two blows along two Ways at one instant so the foe can yield to neither.

name: Twinway Sweep
description: Sweep both Ways across the ground at once and carry every foe on them to the edge.

name: Confluent Tao
description: Meet a technique with its exact natural counterpart so both cancel and nothing reaches the body.

name: Azuretao Palm
description: Strike with a palm as calm and open as a clear sky and as hard to guard against.

name: Azuretao Guard
description: Hold a guard of clear qi through which blows pass like light through glass.

name: Azuretao Step
description: Drift forward with the calm of a cloud and be across the gap before it is seen.

name: Azuretao Counter
description: Let a strike pass through the open sky of the guard and meet it on the far side.

name: Azuretao Rinse
description: Rinse a poison or taint from an ally with a clear flow of calm qi.

name: Azuretao Calm
description: Spread a clear calm that dampens the heat and haste of every foe in reach.

name: Azuretao Strike
description: Throw a blow the foe sees only as it lands because the sky around it was calm.

name: Accord Mending
description: Draw a wounded ally's flesh and qi back into accord until the wound closes of its own course.

name: Accord Passage
description: Pass through a closed barrier as though it were open sky.

name: Settled Hand
description: Strike with a palm that settles into the target like water settling in a bowl.

name: Settled Screen
description: Hold a guard shaped like a shallow bowl that spreads a blow over its whole face.

name: Settled Step
description: Slide to the lowest point of the ground and let the foe pass overhead.

name: Settled Sense
description: Feel where the qi of the room pools lowest and learn who gathers there.

name: Settled Breath
description: Breathe the user's qi down into a level pool ready to be drawn on at once.

name: Settled Counter
description: Let a strike settle into the bowl of the guard and spill back along its own line.

name: Settled Grasp
description: Hold the target in a still pool of qi that resists every ripple of effort.

name: Settled Even
description: Settle an ally's qi flat and even so each of their next moves costs less.

name: Settled Strike
description: Pour the whole level pool of qi through one palm in a single deep blow.

name: Settled Quiet
description: Bring a deep quiet over the field until no foe in it can raise a hand in anger.

name: Levelled Tao
description: Level the target's qi to nothing higher than the ground and seal it there.

name: Uplandtao Palm
description: Strike with the open breadth of the plateau behind the palm and no edge to the blow.

name: Uplandtao Guard
description: Stand wide and open so the blow has no spot on which to land.

name: Uplandtao Step
description: Cross the open ground in long even paces with nothing to catch the foot.

name: Uplandtao Sense
description: Look far across the plateau by feeling what moves on it.

name: Uplandtao Counter
description: Open the body to a blow and let it run out into the wide ground behind.

name: Uplandtao Calm
description: Spread a wide calm that quiets every temper in the user's sight.

name: Uplandtao Clearing
description: Clear a curse or binding from an ally by opening the plateau wide around them.

name: Uplandtao Strike
description: Strike from nowhere in particular with the breadth of the plateau in the blow.

name: Uplandtao Sweep
description: Sweep the open ground with the Way so that every foe on it is carried off its feet.

name: Wide Tao
description: Be anywhere on the plateau in a single breath because the Way has no distance in it.

name: Oathlaw Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn to natural law so that nothing contrary to it can bar the blow.

name: Oathlaw Guard
description: Hold a guard sworn to the law of motion so a blow obeys it and slows.

name: Oathlaw Step
description: Step by the law of falling weight and cross the ground without friction.

name: Oathlaw Sense
description: Feel where a thing breaks natural law and learn what is hidden in the break.

name: Oathlaw Breath
description: Breathe by the law of the tide and have the user's qi rise and fall in time.

name: Oathlaw Binding
description: Hold the target under the weight of natural law so only matching law frees them.

name: Oathlaw Counter
description: Turn a strike on the plain law of motion and let the foe's own force take it back.

name: Oathlaw Calm
description: Hold a sworn calm over the field so that breaking it brings weariness on the breaker.

name: Oathlaw Cleansing
description: Cleanse a binding or curse from an ally by restoring the natural law it broke.

name: Oathlaw Strike
description: Strike with a force that no contrary technique can stop unless it keeps the same law.

name: Oathlaw Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of sworn law that holds against any blow that breaks the law.

name: Sworn Compliance
description: Strike in perfect compliance with natural law so no guard that defies it can hold.

name: Windpath Palm
description: Strike with a palm that rides the wind's easiest path to the target.

name: Windpath Guard
description: Hold a guard that bends with the wind so no blow can stand against it.

name: Windpath Step
description: Step with the wind at the back and let it carry the weight of the pace.

name: Windpath Counter
description: Bend like grass in a gust and rise to return the blow along the same path.

name: Windpath Calm
description: Send a windless calm across the field and still every raised voice.

name: Windpath Mending
description: Draw an ally's wound closed along the path of least effort until the flesh rests whole.

name: Windpath Strike
description: Throw a blow that arrives before the wind that bore it.

name: Windpath Sweep
description: Sweep the path of the wind across the field and clear the ground of every foe.

name: Windpath Vanishing
description: Pass out of sight along the wind and stand in a different place without having crossed the space.
